signals.summary: Sapiens began a broad restructuring with layoffs of about 10% of its 5,400-strong global workforce after Advent's takeover.
About 540 employees, roughly 10% of staff, to be laid off, with India and the US hit hardest.
Calcalist reported the company was preparing to cut about 15% of its workforce, roughly 700-800 employees.
Advent completed its $2.5 billion acquisition, taking Sapiens private and moving headquarters to London.
Sapiens reported 2024 revenues of $524 million with operating profit of $86 million.
New management set a target of at least 10% annual growth while shifting fully to a cloud-based SaaS model.
